Before: a plate of fried rice (~250 g, around 330 kcal) and a plate of yakisoba-style noodles with meat (~250 g, around 400 kcal). There is also a cone-wrapped item, probably ice cream or a dessert, which in the second photo appears to be an opened small cup (maybe a sauce or dessert). The cone is likely an ice cream cone, but the second photo shows only a small foil lid and a wrapper, so it was probably eaten. I'll count about 100 kcal for it, roughly 60 g.

After: the noodles and some rice were combined onto one plate, which holds about 200 g in total. The other plate has only scattered rice remnants, about 20 g. Since the rice and noodles together came to about 500 g and about 220 g is left, the person ate roughly 280 g of the main food.

Energy: the main food is about 730 kcal at 500 g, or about 1.46 kcal/g. Eating 280 g gives about 410 kcal. Adding the dessert at 100 kcal and 60 g gives 510 kcal and 340 g.

Wait: the second photo shows a lot of food still on the plate. The mixed plate looks like about 60% of the noodles plus some rice, so the estimate of about 220 g left is reasonable.
